description: Apply to an open role as the user, with their filmmaker profile as the application (the owner sees the public profile card), an optional note and up to 3 links. The apply form's rules apply unchanged: a creator account with a public filmmaker profile, display name and at least one role; one application per role; not the user's own project; up to 20 applications a day. The owner is e-mailed.

note.description: A note to the owner (up to 600 characters): why the user fits the role.

role_id.description: The role's id (from get_project or search_open_roles).

name: apply_to_role
title: Apply to a role
